title: Claude Code running-session registry entry
description: <Claude config folder>/sessions/<pid>.json: one file per running Claude Code process. The format is internal to Claude Code. hopsesh reads pid, sessionId, status and waitingFor (agents/claude/live.go: a session is open while its process runs; its status is "waiting for <waitingFor>" when that is set) and ignores the rest, which is kept as captured. The file lives in claude/<Claude Code version>/registry/.
